# automox Provider

Manage [Automox](https://www.automox.com/) patch policies, worklets, server groups, maintenance windows, and devices.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    automox = {
      source  = "registry.sweetgreen.engineering/sweetgreen/automox"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

# The API key is sensitive and is read from the environment rather than written
# into configuration, so it stays out of version control and out of state.
#
#   export AUTOMOX_API_KEY="..."
#   export AUTOMOX_ORGANIZATION_ID="120547"
provider "automox" {
  # api_key         = var.automox_api_key      # or AUTOMOX_API_KEY
  # organization_id = 120547                   # or AUTOMOX_ORGANIZATION_ID
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Automox API key. May also be set with the `AUTOMOX_API_KEY` environment variable, which is preferred so the key stays out of configuration files and state.

An **Organization** key reaches policies, server groups, devices, and maintenance windows. Account-level operations additionally require a **Global** key held by a Full Administrator.
- `base_url` (String) Automox Console API base URL. Defaults to `https://console.automox.com/api`. May also be set with the `AUTOMOX_BASE_URL` environment variable. Override only when targeting a regional console.
- `organization_id` (Number) Automox organization (zone) ID. May also be set with the `AUTOMOX_ORGANIZATION_ID` environment variable.

Most Automox endpoints are scoped by this integer. A few are scoped by the organization's UUID instead; the provider resolves that automatically, so only the integer is configured here.
